clips.send: Radius OA joins the center to the rim. Chord AB joins two points on the rim. Diameter UV is a chord through the center. An arc is part of the rim. A diameter perpendicular to a chord bisects the chord and both of its arcs.
clips.text: Radius OA joins the center to the rim. Chord AB joins two points on the rim. Diameter UV is a chord through the center. An arc is part of the rim. A diameter perpendicular to a chord bisects the chord and both of its arcs.

clips.send: Two radii and the arc between them bound a sector. Let n° be the turn at the center along that arc and r be the radius. Divide n° by 360° to find the fraction of a full turn. Multiply the circumference by that fraction for arc length, or multiply the full area by it for sector area.

clips.send: A central angle has its vertex at the center. The vertex P of inscribed angle APB is on the circle, and its sides pass through A and B. It intercepts the arc from A to B that does not contain P. The inscribed angle is half the turn at the center along that same arc.

clips.send: A tangent line meets the circle at exactly one point, the point of tangency. It is perpendicular to the radius there. A line through the outer endpoint of a radius and perpendicular to it is tangent. The distance from an outside point along a tangent to its point of tangency is the tangent length. The two tangent lengths from the same outside point are equal.

clips.send: A cyclic quadrilateral has all four vertices on one circle. Drag A or C and watch ∠B and ∠D change while their sum stays at 180°.

clips.send: 圆心角的顶点在圆心。圆周角 APB 的顶点 P 在圆周上，两边分别经过 A、B。它所对的是从 A 到 B 且不经过 P 的那段弧。圆周角等于同一段弧所对应的圆心转角的一半。

clips.send: 半径 OA 从圆心连到圆周；弦 AB 连接圆周上的两点；直径 UV 是经过圆心的弦；弧是圆周的一段。垂直于弦的直径平分这条弦，也平分弦所对的两条弧。

clips.send: 扇形由两条半径和它们之间的一段弧围成。设沿着这段弧的圆心转角为 n 度 ，半径为 r。用 n 度 除以 360 度 ，就知道扇形占整圆的几分之几。求弧长就用这个分数乘圆周长，求扇形面积就乘整圆面积。

clips.send: 切线与圆只有一个公共点，叫作切点。切线垂直于经过切点的半径。反过来，过半径外端且垂直于该半径的直线是圆的切线。从圆外一点到切点的线段长度叫作切线长。同一个圆外点引出的两条切线的切线长相等。

clips.send: 四个顶点都在同一个圆上的四边形叫圆内接四边形。拖动 A 或 C，观察 ∠B 和 ∠D 怎样一增一减，且它们的和始终等于 180 度 。
